_meta.description: Orbitan Brand Asset Registry — machine-readable inventory of all brand assets

orbitan_symbol_3d_transparent.intended_usage: Primary logo mark — navigation, headers, lockups
orbitan_symbol_3d_transparent.known_limitations: Raster only. No vector master exists. Cannot be used for maskable icons or favicon sizing without quality loss.

orbitan_symbol_blue_circular_on_black.known_limitations: Raster only. Optimised for dark backgrounds. Not suitable for light surfaces.

orbitan_3d_logo_opaque.known_limitations: Raster only. Not specifically composed or sized for 180×180 Apple touch icon or 192/512 PWA icons. Not maskable-safe. Used as interim fallback until vector master exists.

orbitan_3d_logo_transparent_copy.known_limitations: Raster only. Not sized for favicon dimensions (16/32/48). Interim fallback behind SVG favicon.

orbit_nexus_logo.known_limitations: Raster only. No vector master exists. Do not silently redesign.

orbit_ring_favicon.known_limitations: Original Orbit Ring brand element, not the Orbitan 3D logo. Six colour arcs render distinctly at 16×16 and above.

orbitan_symbol_svg.note: Cannot be derived from raster. Requires original vector artwork from founder or designer.

favicon_ico.note: Requires vector master for clean multi-size export.

favicon_png_sizes.note: Requires vector master for clean multi-size export.

maskable_icons.description: PWA maskable icons (192×192, 512×512) with safe-zone composition
maskable_icons.note: Requires artwork composed within 80% safe zone. Ordinary raster logos are NOT maskable-safe and must not be declared as maskable.

apple_touch_icon_180.description: Apple touch icon (180×180, properly composed for iOS)
apple_touch_icon_180.note: Current apple-touch-icon uses interim CDN raster. Not specifically sized or composed for iOS.

social_banner_approved.note: Previous AI-generated placeholder was removed from production metadata (og:image, twitter:image). Requires manual design and founder approval.

orbit_nexus_symbol_svg.note: Approved master is raster PNG. Do not silently redesign.

removed_defects.defect: AI-generated social banner used in og:image and twitter:image
removed_defects.resolution: Removed from index.html. No approved social banner exists. Social image metadata intentionally omitted.

removed_defects.defect: Ordinary CDN raster PNGs declared as purpose:maskable in manifest.json
removed_defects.resolution: Maskable declarations removed. Artwork does not respect maskable safe zone. Proper maskable icons pending source artwork.

removed_defects.defect: OrbitanLoader.jsx hardcoded CDN URL instead of using LOGO_ASSETS
removed_defects.resolution: Added loaderMark key to LOGO_ASSETS. OrbitanLoader now imports and uses LOGO_ASSETS.loaderMark.
